label.en_US: MDM Factory: review the rows held back
label.fr_FR: MDM Factory : revoir les lignes retenues

description.en_US: Opens one task for the data steward to review the landing-to-staging rows held back for a project. Launched by the automatic intake; never blocks a chain.
description.fr_FR: Ouvre une tâche pour que le data steward revoie les lignes retenues entre le landing et le staging d'un projet. Lancé par la prise en charge automatique, sans bloquer.

nodes.label: Review the rows held back
nodes.description: Review the landing-to-staging transfer rejects of this project. The automatic intake carries on with the other rows meanwhile.
